items.title: Inogen Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Sales Rise Y/Y, 2026 View Cut
items.summary: INGN's Q2 revenues rise 3% as international sales climb 14.8%, but U.S. weakness led it to cut its 2026 revenue outlook.

items.title: iRhythm Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Volume Growth, '26 View Raised
items.summary: IRTC posts 20.1% revenue growth, margin expansion and a higher 2026 outlook while advancing innovation and its Vital Connect acquisition.

items.title: Cisco Stock Is Finally Pricing In A New Growth Story
items.summary: Management put a much higher number on its future, and the stock has been on a tear ever since. But is this a fleeting AI boom or a fundamental rewiring of the business.

items.title: XRAY Stock Falls Despite Q2 Earnings Beat, Wellspect Drives Sales
items.summary: DENTSPLY SIRONA's Q2 sales fall 4.1% as dental weakness offsets Wellspect growth, while margins improve and 2026 guidance is maintained.

items.title: AMN Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Staffing and Search Growth, Stock Up
items.summary: AMN Healthcare's Q2 EPS jumps 158% as revenues rise 2.3%, helped by travel nurse, allied and search growth plus labor disruption activity.

items.title: DOCS Q1 Earnings Miss on Higher AI Costs, Revenues Beat, FY27 View Up
items.summary: Doximity raises fiscal 2027 revenue guidance as AI adoption and pharma demand fuel growth, even as higher AI investments pressure margins.

items.title: PacBio Q2 Earnings Meet Estimates, Revenues Miss, 2026 Sales View Cut
items.summary: PACB cuts its 2026 revenue outlook after Q2 sales fall 2%, as consumables and EMEA growth fail to offset weaker instruments and Asia-Pacific.

items.title: LivaNova Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, '26 Outlook Raised
items.summary: LIVN's Q2 earnings and revenues beat estimates as Cardiopulmonary and Epilepsy growth fuels margin gains and a raised 2026 outlook.
